# dbml-editor

> Frontend viewer/editor for a restricted DBML dialect. No backend. If you were sent here from another codebase to generate a `.dbml` file, read AGENTS.md and follow it. Do not emit full dbdiagram.io DBML.

## Documentation

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amkmonk/dbml-editor/main/AGENTS.md): how to generate a compatible `.dbml` from any project's schema
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amkmonk/dbml-editor/main/README.md): how to run the editor and dialect examples humans can open
- [AGENTS.md CLI section](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amkmonk/dbml-editor/main/AGENTS.md): `node bin/dbml-editor.js check|stats|layout|sql|sync` — validate, auto-arrange and sync a `.dbml` with a live PostgreSQL schema without a browser
